vulnerability.name: USN-8503-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that ncurses incorrectly handled certain terminfo entries in the infocmp tool. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service via a crafted terminfo file.  The default compiler options for affected releases should reduce the vulnerability to a denial of service.

statements.status_notes: ncurses could be made to crash if it opened a specially crafted file. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
